author: Phoofi
body:
This is 100% addressed to all staff members !

I look to apply in the month of August and would like to get a little insight on what its like to be a staff member .
There are a few questions I would like to ask regarding this topic , that being ..

1).What are some duties and responsibilities do you as a staff member have to for fill ?

2).In your opinion can just anyone become a staff member ? (Coming from your experience as a staff member)

3).How much time do you put towards your career at Avicus ?

Thank you for your time !

title: What's It like to be a staff member !

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Sure thing.

1) It depends what position you are talking about. In my personal position, I basically sit here and run the server. Sometimes I handle complaints, sometimes I make a new advertising document, sometimes I make updates, sometimes I promote people, sometimes I debate. It really is a wide variety of things that I do as administrator.

2) I feel like anyone has the ability to control their behaviour, and come on the server to simply moderate. But when you extend into senior moderator, and administrator, I think some level of knowledge must be essential to become one. For example you should have decent leadership skills, in order to become an administrator (or a good one).

3) I'm on daily, with the exception of vacation time, and sometimes school interference.
